reviews.reliability: UTF-8 input/output are explicit and boundary matching mirrors the legacy ASCII regex. Contracts/paths are trusted internal input; null/duplicate names and non-ASCII C# identifier boundaries need invalid-input tests.

reviews.performance: Standalone Roslyn package executable disables project analyzers and avoids application references.
reviews.reliability: Package/SDK changes must invalidate the launcher build cache; this XML alone does not prove the compilation context matches a production project.

reviews.performance: Parses every context tree once, but walks syntax repeatedly, discovers project ancestors per path, and builds compilations per target project. Cache project/namespace metadata per pass and use a combined syntax visitor.
reviews.reliability: Syntax/semantic identities retain explicit fallback; unresolved compilation diagnostics are not reported. ExpectedNamespace uses project filename instead of evaluated RootNamespace, and HTTP property optionality is a syntactic approximation.

reviews.performance: Links the exact MCP ranking core and protocol records into the existing reader assembly, avoiding duplicate implementations.
reviews.reliability: Narrow Sqlite reference and copied runtime assemblies are explicit; linked source, package and SDK identities must stay in build fingerprints.

reviews.performance: Ranks through the shared core then opens another connection for bounded-path features. It hydrates only selected candidate paths, but feature enrichment scans all representations of those paths.
reviews.reliability: Second connection is not pinned to the same read transaction as ranking, so direct live-root enrichment needs a concurrency/freshness fixture. Missing/duplicate candidate features throw rather than inventing them.

reviews.performance: Runtime/architecture groups use one command, but SQL returns all matching records and per-kind limits are applied in managed code. Move bounds into SQL with exact per-group order parity; diagnostics are already optional.
reviews.reliability: Read-only connection, source hash and 2-second commands fail on stale projection. Metadata/payload/diagnostic reads are not one transaction; wildcard characters are escaped and groups are fixed code.

reviews.performance: Each group has SQL LIMIT, but counts/byte diagnostics and total scan counts run even when diagnostics are off. Skip those computations and consider one bounded multi-group query.
reviews.reliability: Supported views/limits and LIKE escaping are explicit. Read-only source hash is checked before separate group queries; pin a read transaction to prevent mixed projections during live refresh.

reviews.performance: 128 samples per command/stage bound percentile work, but global command/stage key dictionaries have no explicit cardinality cap. Capture sorts bounded windows under locks.
reviews.reliability: Counters use Interlocked and timing windows are locked. Only aggregate names/timings are stored; callers must keep command/stage labels fixed and not use query/path text.

reviews.performance: Status reads source/index/MCP hashes and two receipts every call; Git-directory/head resolution is repeated and per-index 80 KiB buffers allocate repeatedly. Share request-owned discovery and one buffer without weakening content checks.
reviews.reliability: Generation/verification/running-code freshness are distinct. Multiple reads are not one atomic worktree snapshot; exact HEAD vs content receipt interpretation and filesystem failures need typed-state coverage.

reviews.performance: Watcher generations, HEAD checks, scope projection and serialized creation avoid many Git scans; scoped projection still hashes all changed relevant bytes each call. Watcher traverses the full root and pending paths can grow during large edits.
reviews.reliability: NUL status parsing retains destination but skips rename source, and OnChanged does not record RenamedEventArgs.OldFullPath. Scoped moved-out invalidation needs a deterministic fixture. Whole-worktree snapshot reuse assumes watcher delivery/error detection.

reviews.performance: Structured JSON is traversed repeatedly for paths, commands and warnings. A single classification pass and cached empty-array/object values may reduce parsing/compaction allocations.
reviews.reliability: Regex root list excludes Modules and Tools roots, potentially dropping current module scope. Invalid structured JSON becomes text rather than typed parse failure; path validation is not anchored to the whole value. Trace excludes low-confidence candidates explicitly.

reviews.performance: Compaction bounds selected arrays and removes raw output, but clones and serializes another JSON graph and repeatedly constructs empty fallback arrays/objects.
reviews.reliability: Trace keeps status/warnings/limitations and truncation flags. ChangeContext clears top-level warnings/checks while leaving structured obligations; malformed boolean/path kinds and negative caller limits need robustness checks.

reviews.performance: 64 hash-striped gates coalesce identical misses without retaining payload keys; unrelated keys can serialize on a stripe. Development bundle runs brief/test plan concurrently and rechecks snapshots afterward.
reviews.reliability: Fresh SQLite candidates drive scope and unavailable states remain explicit; no stale JSON fallback. Standalone calls do not perform final snapshot checks, module Presentation/PersistenceModel layer inference is incomplete, and refresh-success telemetry means process completion rather than fresh search readiness.

reviews.performance: Every event synchronously locks, rereads/rewrites up to 1000 events and flushes to disk; high query rates can make telemetry part of interactive latency. Batch aggregate persistence needs contention/recoverability tests.
reviews.reliability: Named mutex and unique atomic temp files serialize writers; recognized I/O/JSON/timeout failures are reflected in health. Capture trusts persisted event count/content, so valid oversized or malformed envelopes need validation; no query payload is persisted.

reviews.performance: Executes complete bundles serially and stores all results; explicit maximumCases bounds an optional subset and percentile computation is small.
reviews.reliability: Requires unique valid case IDs, SQLite primary, expected top-ten path and complete bundle; output is written before failure. Null arrays/elements and actual persisted evidence growth need invalid-input tests.

reviews.performance: Thin adapter reuses the shared reader and one aggregate stopwatch per single/batch operation; batch avoids per-query telemetry writes.
reviews.reliability: Cancellation/expected fingerprint are propagated and timing is recorded in finally without query data. The adapter delegates all state/limit/transaction enforcement to the linked ranking core.

reviews.performance: Concrete SQLite batches reuse one read snapshot; fake/interface readers retain sequential evaluation. Metrics store all corpus results and timing arrays.
reviews.reliability: Schema, limits and duplicate IDs are checked, but null case/criteria arrays and threshold ranges need fixtures. Ready is recorded rather than included in the aggregate passed criterion; caller gates must reject unavailable states independently.

reviews.performance: Runs complete bundles serially and serializes compact context per case; warm timing excludes only the first case. Shared equivalent queries can reuse service cache, but representativeness of warm/cold metrics needs explicit workload controls.
reviews.reliability: Ranking/scope/named-test/required-path invariants are strict and thresholds explicit. Null/invalid threshold and expected-layer values need validation. HasFocusedChecks treats any nonempty recommended/discovery list as a check, which is planning evidence rather than executed coverage.
